notes:
Carbonated water, either plain or used as a mixer. Composed of ⟦ソーダ→ソーダ：11032_sooda⟧ (soda, from English) + {水|すい} (water). In Japan, ソーダ{水|すい} specifically refers to plain carbonated water without added sweeteners, distinguishing it from flavored sodas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ソーダ{水|すい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧ — to dilute/mix with soda water
- ⟦ハイボール→ハイボール：27604_haibooru⟧ — highball (whisky + soda water, extremely popular in Japan)
- ⟦{焼酎|しょうちゅう}→焼酎：19874_shouchuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ソーダ→ソーダ：11032_sooda⟧{割|わ}り — shochu mixed with soda water
- ⟦レモン→レモン：10456_remon⟧ソーダ{水|すい} — lemon soda water

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{炭酸水|たんさんすい}→炭酸水：15327_tansansui⟧ — carbonated water (the more common everyday term)
- ⟦{炭酸|たんさん}{飲料|いんりょう}→炭酸飲料：19494_tansaninryou⟧ — carbonated beverage (broader category including cola, etc.)
- サイダー — cider (in Japan, means lemon-lime soda, not apple cider)
- ラムネ — ramune (traditional Japanese marble-sealed soda)
